checklists.title: Road trip prep
checklists.markdown:
# Road trip prep

## Car check
- [ ] Tire pressure (including spare)
- [ ] Oil level
- [ ] Washer fluid
- [ ] Lights and turn signals
- [ ] Wipers

## Fuel budget

```calc
title Trip fuel cost
input distance = 300 | Distance (mi)
input mpg = 30 | Fuel economy (mpg)
input price = 3.50 | Gas price ($/gal)
let gallons = distance / mpg
show stops = ceil(gallons / 12) | Fill-ups (12 gal tank)
show cost = round(gallons * price, 2) | Fuel cost ($)
```

- [ ] Budget ${{cost}} for fuel

## In the car
- [ ] Phone mount and charger
- [ ] Offline maps downloaded
- [ ] Water and snacks
- [ ] Sunglasses
- [ ] Registration and insurance card

checklists.title: Day hike
checklists.markdown:
# Day hike

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Tell someone your route and when you expect to be back.

## Water & food

```calc
title Water to carry
input hours = 4 | Hours on the trail
input temp = 70 | Temperature (°F)
let rate = if(temp >= 85, 1, 0.5)
show liters = round(hours * rate, 1) | Liters of water
```

- [ ] Water: {{liters}} L
- [ ] Snacks / lunch
- [ ] Electrolytes

## The ten essentials
- [ ] Navigation (map, offline map on phone)
- [ ] Headlamp
- [ ] Sun protection
- [ ] First aid kit
- [ ] Knife / multitool
- [ ] Fire starter
- [ ] Emergency shelter
- [ ] Extra food
- [ ] Extra water
- [ ] Extra clothes

## At the trailhead
- [ ] Check the weather one more time
- [ ] Note the time you start

checklists.title: Monthly home check
checklists.markdown:
# Monthly home check
<!-- repeat: monthly -->

- [ ] Test smoke and CO detectors
- [ ] Check HVAC filter (replace every 1–3 months)
- [ ] Clean the dishwasher filter
- [ ] Run water in unused sinks and showers
- [ ] Check under sinks for leaks
- [ ] Clean the range hood filter

checklists.title: Packing list
checklists.markdown:
# Packing list

## Documents
- [ ] ID / passport
- [ ] Tickets and reservations (saved offline)
- [ ] Credit card + some cash

## Clothes
- [ ] Shirts — one per day, plus one
- [ ] Pants / shorts
- [ ] Underwear and socks
- [ ] Sleepwear
- [ ] Jacket or layer for the weather

## Toiletries
- [ ] Toothbrush and toothpaste
- [ ] Deodorant
- [ ] Medications
- [ ] Sunscreen

## Electronics
- [ ] Phone charger
- [ ] Battery pack
- [ ] Headphones

> [!TIP]
> Lay everything out on the bed before it goes in the bag.

checklists.title: Before leaving home
checklists.markdown:
# Before leaving home

- [ ] Take out the trash
- [ ] Empty or clear the fridge of anything that will spoil
- [ ] Turn down the thermostat
- [ ] Unplug small appliances
- [ ] Water plants / arrange plant care
- [ ] Lock windows
- [ ] Lock the door
